subject.title: feat: add Codex session MCP profile

question: Should this PR advertise the experimental Codex native sidebar collection metadata before that contract exists in current open-source Codex main?
rationale: The global MCP App path is backed by directly inspected Codex contracts, but `sidebar-collection`, `listTool`, and `replacesGlobal` are absent from current Codex source; accepting them requires explicit cross-product intent rather than an implementation inference.

options.title: Gate collection metadata
options.body: Keep the verified global MCP App fallback and emit native collection metadata only behind a confirmed experimental Codex integration boundary.

options.title: Approve forward contract
options.body: Land the metadata now as a coordinated cross-product experiment and accept that current open-source Codex ignores it.

options.title: Remove collection metadata
options.body: Ship only the verified global MCP App profile until Codex exposes a native collection contract.

recommendation.title: Gate collection metadata
recommendation.body: Keep the verified global MCP App fallback and emit native collection metadata only behind a confirmed experimental Codex integration boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the affected MCP bridge and has the strongest history-backed connection to this cross-product direction.
